descFull: All-in-one open source Session Border Controller in pure Go: a SIP/WebRTC edge proxy that keeps FreeSWITCH or Asterisk off the public internet. One static binary, one YAML file: SIP proxy for phones and carriers, RTP/SRTP relay, WebRTC gateway, built-in SIP security.
